name: ecoturismo-la-yeguada-obc
description: Monorepo: backend NLP + dashboard frontend — Ecoturismo La Yeguada OBC (TFG UNA)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix yeguada-backend && npm install --prefix yeguada-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix yeguada-backend" "npm start --prefix yeguada-frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm start --prefix yeguada-backend" "npm start --prefix yeguada-frontend"
